canonical_reference: Pinned official Transformers 4.51.3 Qwen2 implementation, exact checkpoint weights promoted to float32, eager attention, CPU deterministic settings
comparison_reference: Official bfloat16 checkpoint execution retained separately; equality of free-running tokens across arithmetic dtypes is not required or claimed
weight_storage: Preserve original BF16 bits; lossless expansion into f32. FP32 resident storage also lossless. No implicit BF16-to-f16 conversion

generation.selection: raw-logit argmax, smallest index on exact ties

scope: Initial numerical policy fixed after CPU activation/dtype characterization and before CSL layer/model candidate results. Includes all original fixed prompts; later adversarial/capacity inputs are additive. A failure requires implementation diagnosis, not post-hoc tolerance relaxation.
